entry_points: src/minimax/train.py __main__ (parses Parsnip args, builds ExperimentRunner, Logger, optional wandb, calls xp_runner.train)

src/minimax/runners/xp_runner.py ExperimentRunner.train / step (outer while loop over n_total_updates: calls runner.run each tick, times steps, logs csv every log_interval, evaluates every test_interval, checkpoints every checkpoint_interval / archive_interval; _make_shmap_run shards over devices)
src/minimax/runners/dr_runner.py DRRunner.run (one update: reset batch env to fresh random levels, roll out students, PPO update)

src/minimax/runners/plr_runner.py PLRRunner.run (PLR / Robust PLR / ACCEL / Parallel PLR / Parallel ACCEL: sample replay-or-new via PLRManager, dedupe, evaluate and update buffer, gradient update, optional mutation step)
src/minimax/runners/paired_runner.py PAIREDRunner (teacher policy designs levels via UEDEnvironment.step_teacher; student/antagonist trained; regret-based ued_score)

src/minimax/util/rl/plr.py PLRManager (PLRBuffer pytree; sample, dedupe_levels, update, _get_replay_dist = (1-staleness_coef)*score_dist + staleness_coef*staleness_dist with rank scores and temperature; PopPLRManager for populations)
src/minimax/evaluate.py __main__ (loads checkpoint.pkl per xpid, evaluates on --env_names for --n_episodes, writes results csv)
src/minimax/config/make_cmd.py __main__ (expands JSON grid configs in config/ into python -m minimax.train command lines; copies bundled configs on first run)
example_input: JSON config src/minimax/config/configs/maze/plr.json (seed 1, train_runner plr, env_name Maze, n_total_updates 30000, n_parallel 32, n_rollout_steps 256, ued_score max_mc, plr_replay_prob 0.5, plr_buffer_size 4000, plr_staleness_coef 0.3, plr_temp 0.3, plr_use_robust_plr true, maze 13x13 with 60 walls, test_env_names Maze-SixteenRooms,Maze-Labyrinth,Maze-StandardMaze); the generated command is then pasted and run. Evaluation: python -m minimax.evaluate --seed 1 --log_dir <abs path> --xpid_prefix <prefix> --env_names <csv> --n_episodes <n> --results_path <dir> --results_fname <csv>
example_output: <log_dir>/<xpid>/logs.csv (one row per log_interval rollout cycles), checkpoint.pkl (latest), checkpoint_<N>.tar archives when --archive_interval > 0, meta.json; minimax.evaluate writes a results csv (README Logging/Checkpointing/Evaluating sections)

built_to: Provide fast, fully-jittable JAX implementations of the key minimax-regret UED baselines (DR, Minimax adversary, PAIRED, Population PAIRED, PLR, Robust PLR, ACCEL) plus two new parallel variants (Parallel PLR, Parallel ACCEL), with multi-device training and a tensorized maze environment (AMaze) reproducing the MiniGrid mazes of prior UED work.
pressure: README: 'existing implementations of common baselines require excessive amounts of compute. In some cases, experiments can require more than a week to complete using V100 GPUs. This long turn-around slows the rate of research progress in autocuriculum methods'.
success_means: README: wall-time speedups ('over 100x faster than previous reference implementations, like those in facebookresearch/dcd' in timing studies on V100 GPUs and Xeon E5-2698 v4 CPUs), exact reproduction of MiniGrid maze dynamics/reward/observation/action spaces, and student performance on held-out test mazes (test_env_names such as Maze-SixteenRooms, Maze-Labyrinth, Maze-StandardMaze, evaluated every test_interval and by minimax.evaluate).
main_loop_one_sentence: ExperimentRunner.train loops while train_state.n_updates < n_total_updates, each tick calling the selected runner's run() (jitted, optionally shmap-sharded over devices) which for PLRRunner resets a batch of fresh random levels, asks PLRManager.sample whether to replay (uniform draw < replay_prob and buffer fill >= min_fill_ratio) and if so draws levels from the buffer with a distribution mixing rank-based score weights and staleness (ages), optionally merges new+replay+mutated levels for parallel evaluation, dedupes against the buffer, rolls out the students and computes UED scores (e.g. max_mc) to insert/update buffer entries, performs the PPO gradient update (gated by is_replay under Robust PLR), then under ACCEL mutates the replayed levels with the registered mutator and evaluates the children into the buffer, before the outer loop logs stats to csv/wandb and checkpoints.
behavioral_entry_point: src/minimax/runners/plr_runner.py:PLRRunner.run and PLRRunner._eval_and_update_plr / _mutate_levels; src/minimax/util/rl/plr.py:PLRManager.sample / _get_replay_dist / update; src/minimax/util/rl/ued_scores.py:compute_ued_scores (UEDScore enum: RELATIVE_REGRET, MEAN_RELATIVE_REGRET, POPULATION_REGRET, RETURN, NEG_RETURN, L1_VALUE_LOSS, POSITIVE_VALUE_LOSS, MAX_MC, VALUE_DISAGREEMENT); src/minimax/envs/maze/maze_mutators.py:move_goal_flip_walls; src/minimax/envs/registration.py (register / register_ued / register_mutator / register_comparator)
lineage_notes: README: JAX-based reimplementation of the baselines in facebookresearch/dcd ('previous reference implementations, like those in facebookresearch/dcd'); AMaze 'provides feature-parity with respect to the previous reference implementation of the maze environment in facebookresearch/dcd' and 'exactly reproduces the MiniGrid-based mazes used in previous UED studies'. Introduces Parallel PLR and Parallel ACCEL as new variants. rnn.py is based on OptimizedLSTMCell from google/jax. Roadmap names JaxMARL and Jumanji as planned integrations. (Downstream, per the jaxued tree, JaxUED credits minimax commit 2ae9e04 for ued_scores and maze mutators.)
